Around 15 minutes later.
Bot: I think I found something…
Shanice: What is it?!
Bot: A charred notepad.
Shanice: We can’t really read anything from it, pages crumble on touch…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Even I can’t recover any information from this.
Bot: There’s something on the back cover though. {{wi}}Letters. {{wi}}DT.
Shanice: DT? What could it mean?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It could mean all sorts of things.
Bot: It seems kinda…
Shanice: What?
Bot: Nevermind. It’s nothing.
Bot: Can we go now?
Shanice: Alright. We looked through this whole place. Let’s go home.
You: Sure.
Shanice: Thank you two for helping me. This means a lot.
Bot: No problem. I also wanted to learn something about myself. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: God be with you.
